column1: # latin_lexicon.tsv - stress lexicon for latin.py (Ecclesiastical Latin).
#   key    the word in lower case, accents stripped, ae/oe for æ/œ, i for j (v kept)
#   form   the word with an acute on the stressed vowel; j = consonantal i; a diaeresis
#          keeps two vowels apart (Míchaël, áër); | forces a syllable break after a prefix
#          (súb|leva, ób|ruta); macrons/breves may mark vowel length
#   source own    = stress from the author's knowledge of Latin quantities and liturgical use
#          accent = the stress printed in the site's own liturgical texts
#   note   ?      = uncertain;  name = applies only to a capitalised word (María, not maria "seas")
# Built from a review of every word of the site's Latin prayers whose stress the rules
# could not decide or decided wrongly, plus the common prayers. Add words here when
